name: CSV File Formatter
description: A file-field formatter that reads an uploaded CSV file and renders its contents as an HTML table on the entity display, with optional DataTables enhancement.
library_dependencies: datatables.net (optional, DataTables 2.2.2, loaded from CDN or local /libraries only when the 'Use DataTables' setting is enabled)
project_description: A Field formatter that renders CSV files uploaded to a Drupal File field as a themable HTML table. Provides the 'CSV file as table' formatter for core file fields, with settings for header row, field separator / enclosure / escape characters, per-table/header/row CSS classes, UTF-8 re-encoding, sticky headers, an optional original-file download link (before or after the table), smart URL/email/Markdown-link handling of cell content, and optional client-side enhancement through the DataTables JavaScript library (sorting, searching, pagination, scrolling) loaded from a CDN or from locally installed library files.
